reason: The audit's own in-memory examples are rm(...) strings fed to the scanner, not removals.
A comment naming the call shape the helper replaces, not a removal.

restore() is synchronous: every caller restores from a finally without awaiting, so it removes the stub directory it created with rmSync under removeFixture's own retry bounds instead of the async helper (RP-348).

Removes a single symlink created mid-test (node_modules/@nizos/probity) so a second symlink can be written at the same path for the next assertion within the same fixture; removeFixture targets a whole fixture directory, not one link inside a still-live one (RP-416 round 2).
